assertion.statement: The weight-m Hall commutators give an exact integer lattice basis; the length-R subset is the basis of T. Extending eta by zero on the remaining weight-m basis elements gives an integral character on G_m.
assertion.objects: Central G_m, T=G_(m,R), Gamma, surviving weighted Hall commutators.
assertion.hypotheses: Exact LP04 upward-closed monomial quotient; no weight above m; no weight-m word of length above R; eta integral on T intersect Gamma.
assertion.quantifiers: Every fixed such quotient and every integral real character eta on T.
assertion.parameter_range: 1<=R<=m; all finite alphabets, including empty retained subsets.
assertion.uniformity: The extension and resulting smooth test depend only on fixed Hall ordering and eta.
assertion.constants: Assigned values on lower-length weight-m Hall basis are zero; all assigned values are integers.
assertion.normalizations: Weight is the manuscript grading, length is bracket length. At weight m all higher-weight BCH corrections vanish.
assertion.exceptional_cases: T may be strictly smaller than P_m or G_m. No arbitrary rational-subgroup saturation theorem is assumed.
assertion.limit_order: Choose eta_bar and Ftilde before the LP04 comparison and before the limit orbit.

uses.available_from_supplier: LP04 proves exact integral Hall coordinates and lattice intersections for these monomial quotients.
uses.needed_here: A character on all of G_m, then on P_m, rather than only on T.
uses.connecting_derivation: Section 2 identifies the central weight-m basis, extends integer values by zero, and constructs a global smooth equivariant unit-vector test by finite torus-bundle charts. It includes a counterexample to treating T-equivariance as sufficient.

assertion.statement: The abelian rational petal ideal splits by unique petal letters, and the maps M_t are additive in t on P, commute with G conjugation, preserve weight filtrations, and preserve Lambda for integral t. These identities make rho_t(g,p)=(g M_t(p),p) a real automorphism and an integral-lattice automorphism for integral t.
assertion.objects: P=direct sum of P_a, M_t, Gamma, Lambda=P intersect Gamma; K and rho.
assertion.hypotheses: All commutators with at least two petals vanish at every weight; core conjugation preserves the unique-petal summands.
assertion.quantifiers: All real parameter tuples t,u, all g in G and p in P; all integer tuples z.
assertion.parameter_range: Arbitrary signs and zero entries; finite ell including zero.
assertion.uniformity: Groups and actions depend only on the fixed quotient.
assertion.constants: rho_t inverse is rho_-t; M_0 acts trivially on P and need not be an automorphism.
assertion.normalizations: M_t is used on P; its additive identity is not asserted on the whole nonabelian G.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Zero scalars are allowed. Preservation by M_z alone is not surjectivity; using both rho_z and rho_-z proves lattice automorphism.
assertion.limit_order: Universal real identities are proved before extension to internal parameters.

uses.available_from_supplier: LP04 supplies the exact real actions and integer-lattice preservation.
uses.needed_here: Associative semidirect laws, all filtered commutators, a lattice, and an exact orbit reduction.
uses.connecting_derivation: Sections 3-5 prove the shear automorphism identity, right-action law, Lie bracket, grading, all filtered lattice intersections, explicit compact representatives and right multiplication by (-z_h,1,1).

assertion.statement: Polynomial maps between the same I-filtered groups form a group under pointwise multiplication. For the specified N^2 source filtration D and target H this proves polynomiality of the product defining O on all Z^2.
assertion.objects: D=Z^2 with D10=Z x 0,D01=0 x Z, other positive groups zero; H with the filtration in Section 4; the three factors in O.
assertion.hypotheses: Both groups are indexed by I=N^2; all target commutator inclusions proved; each separate factor is polynomial for exactly those source and target filtrations.
assertion.quantifiers: All finite pointwise products of these polynomial maps; every integer pair and every iterated difference with increments in the source filtration.
assertion.parameter_range: All real orbit coefficients; all positive finite m; arbitrary negative integer increments.
assertion.uniformity: The polynomial property holds exactly; no coefficient-dependent estimate is introduced.
assertion.constants: Orbit multidegree at most (1,m); group class at most m+1.
assertion.normalizations: Same source and target index set, pointwise multiplication in displayed right-action convention.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The higher target groups are trivial; source mixed-positive group is zero. No Taylor theorem B.9 or printed composition B.5 is imported.
assertion.limit_order: Prove real polynomiality on all Z^2 first; then extend to internal integer pairs.

uses.connecting_derivation: Section 5 defines D explicitly, checks the embeddings and all separate-factor differences, and applies B.4 to their product. Binomial factors are checked in their one-parameter subgroups.

assertion.statement: Under all LP04 comparison hypotheses, chi_h tensor conjugate(Ftilde(b_h Gamma)) has strictly smaller degree-rank. Replacing Ftilde by a function with the extended character leaves the comparison valid because its restriction to T is the same eta.
assertion.objects: LP04 G,G0,phi, a_h,c_h,F_h, eta, b_h; the new Ftilde and the final two-variable chi.
assertion.hypotheses: Every LP04 comparison premise, including filtered lattice-compatible phi, matching horizontal Taylor torus data, normalization, rational taut comparison geometry and exact vertical F_h identity; plus the exact family (2).
assertion.quantifiers: Every h in the subfamily where those hypotheses hold and every integer n; full natural extensions.
assertion.parameter_range: 1<=R<=m; same fixed finite dimensions and uniform test bounds as LP04.
assertion.uniformity: The new Ftilde has fixed finite dimension and bound; finitely many components suffice for the recovery identity.
assertion.constants: No division by a component; sum_b |Ftilde_b|^2=1 exactly.
assertion.normalizations: Tensor comparison uses complex conjugation; zero padding is a fixed isometric coordinate inclusion.
assertion.exceptional_cases: R=1 yields ordinary degree at most m-1; R>1 requires genuine further rank iteration. This packet does not establish that iteration.
assertion.limit_order: Choose Ftilde with eta_bar first, run LP04 comparison, then choose a fixed box/dense subfamily. All-limit identities hold.

assertion.statement: The displayed published core and petal products have exactly b_h=g0 M_{fractional(alpha h)}(g1), with g1 independent of h, by the generator scaling identity and commutativity of P.
assertion.objects: Core coefficients gamma, petal coefficients beta, slope vector alpha, weighted generator products.
assertion.hypotheses: Coefficient decomposition has already been supplied by the earlier analytic/rank arguments; the all-weight petal quotient is the fixed LP04 quotient.
assertion.quantifiers: All real coefficient tuples and all h,n for the displayed family.
assertion.parameter_range: No restriction on sizes, signs, or fractional-part locations.
assertion.uniformity: All orbit variation is in coefficients, not in geometry or tests.
assertion.constants: Equality is exact, with no error term.
assertion.normalizations: Order of core factors retained; petal product commutes; no core-petal reordering is asserted.
assertion.exceptional_cases: An arbitrary original chi_h is not asserted to have this form without the LP04 comparison premises.
assertion.limit_order: Data decomposition precedes the construction; the algebraic equality holds on every real parameter specialization and internal extension.
